descriptions.d24i_grid_scan_8010c494: Scan a 7 by 7 cell grid: for each cell whose edge test 0x8010bd74 passes, seek the run-length cursor at +28 to the key (layer << 10) + row + (column << 5), read the run value and draw the cell's two triangles (0x8010b318) from the corner heights, using strides of 72 bytes per row and 1296 per column.
